package.description: Developer Operations TUI — browse, parameterize, and execute runbooks from the terminal

en-US.description: Developer Operations TUI — browse, parameterize, and execute runbooks from the terminal
en-US.longDescription:
dops is a terminal UI and web UI for browsing, parameterizing, and executing operational runbooks.
It supports catalogs of shell-based runbooks with typed parameters, risk levels, encrypted vault storage,
an MCP server for AI tool integration, and a built-in web interface.
en-US.name: dops
